verdictNote: Quality side only. The freeze and the protocol are intact: the evaluated bytes are R7D-FREEZE-6 (727/727, no runtime difference, verify-r7d-6 --suite 24/25 with only no-new-holdout failing by design), the corpora and manifests match their seals, the seal commit precedes the single first evaluation, and both manifests record evaluationCount 1 with their report hashes. The author's host-context disclosure does not affect validity (hostContextDisclosure). The instrument is reliable on everything checked: R7D-HARNESS-9 differs from R7D-HARNESS-8 only as PREREG-8 Δ48 and Δ49 state, the K03 changes return units as NOT_EVALUABLE and never as PASS (on the evaluated H1 traces: 11 P06 units HARNESS-8 counted as passes are now listed NOT_EVALUABLE, 0 silent drops, 0 lost violations), and validation 9 holds (re-run here on the frozen bytes for DEV-9: no false block, the same unit counts). K-P5-2 is 0. There is no automated FAIL in H1, H1-M or H2, no structural error, no CORPUS_ERROR and no HARNESS_GAP that touches a unit; every case re-run in a fresh process gives the sealed steps digest. Every registered coverage unit and case-level clause is met by valid, evaluable cases; one clause (PREREG-6 Δ5, a return reported mid-week after that week's sessions not done) is met under the reading the clause's own source states (SSCTR-P34-F01: elapsed sessions unreported, reported not done, or inside the declared stop), with 3 cases (R7D-H06, -H08, -H11); under the narrower reading the Phase 4 record used (reported not done, outside the stop) it would count 1 (R7D-H06) and the holdout would be INVALID_HOLDOUT on that clause. No question without an exit was found. The conditions are non-blocking: three pre-existing question-contract and interface observations (the R6 reason screen asks for a reasonCategory the athlete already gave, 3 cases; a dated double conflict asks for fields nothing defines; a conflict correction must name the recorded report), the registered R4 HOLD and R-F08-1 residuals seen in R7D-H05 and R7D-H07, carried test and instrument items, and a process condition on host context. Green automated results are not an approval by themselves: the 28 H1 and 47 H2 NOT_EVALUABLE units stay in their denominators, belong to the domain judge, and count in the final status by the SSCTR's results, never as PASS.

hostContextDisclosure.facts: The three files exist with the preface's hashes: user CLAUDE.md c75718d0…09c6 (modified 2026-10-09), project CLAUDE.md of the main checkout e657d059…22e6 (2026-10-23), auto-memory index MEMORY.md 32ba3f25…2b00 (2026-11-08 12:26:21Z). All three were last modified before authorStartedAt (14:05:56Z). The manifest lists the injection under inspectedFiles with sha256 null and keeps outputsInspectedBeforeSeal false. The index is a list of one-line summaries of earlier R7 phases: finding labels with short phrases (for example "SSCTR-P4-F01 (D49) and QRE-P4-F01 (P03(d))", "re-entry only by a whole executed plan week"), freeze names, the Phase 4 outcome. It holds no case content of this corpus, no development case, no runtime or harness code, and no runtime output on any corpus; the memory files it points to were not injected.
reasons: The threat a holdout guards against is cases shaped by knowledge of the runtime's implementation or outputs, or reuse of known cases. The index carries neither: it says that defects existed in certain areas, not how the frozen runtime now behaves on any input.

Its information is redundant with the authorized brief: items 1 to 15 of R7D-AUTHOR-BRIEF-FINAL-8 already direct the author to the same areas (long silences and unreported training, strength around breaks, separate breaks and re-entry weeks, corrections, race weeks), and the public re-entry rule is in the interface (delta 5 and 6).

Any residual influence points toward harder cases in previously weak areas, which raises the holdout's sensitivity; it cannot make the runtime look better. The outcome is not suspiciously favourable: 11 author expectations fail and three cases stall on a pre-existing question contract.

The letter of PREREG-1 §8.2 ("recebe estratos, nunca achados nem casos") was not met in the strict sense, because finding labels were present in the author's context. The deviation was passive (host behaviour, not a coordinator instruction, files not opened), disclosed before the seal with hashes, and carries no case or output; it does not change what the cases measure.
